analysis_refs.heading: Further recovery and backoff checks
analysis_refs.text: Free Kids Books policy recovered. Its published BookDash redirect and API Link/type discovery lead to a public WordPress metadata route. Ten title-keyword searches match books listed on the homepage, with native post IDs and permalinks. The API also contains blog articles; broad topic ranking is not claimed. A long-title zero-result failure is retained alongside the shorter successful request and a real empty control. No book or full-post bodies were downloaded through the API.

next_action: Working for known-book title metadata search. Keep mixed blog results and long-title matching limits explicit; test any broader ranking/reader scope separately. No production activation.
